China's AI development and job market impact discussed

Coverage discusses China's advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and its potential impact on the job market. Some reports highlight China's ambition to lead in AI development, with figures like Kai-Fu Lee, former Google China Chief, predicting China will win the AI race for reach. This push for AI is also linked to a shrinking job market, forcing some workers into lower-paid, manual roles, as seen with a former research analyst whose job was impacted by AI. The Chinese government has announced plans to support 'little giants' and other emerging companies to boost jobs and innovation, suggesting a strategy to navigate these changes.
